name: Last Song
source:
Marina is an ordinary girl student with only special ability to play guitar fast. As graduation approaches, boys and girls want to create good memories of their study. They all think of love, but need to give their expectations some form. "Why don't we form a music band?" - someone asked, and everyone agreed happily.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
泽村真理奈只是一名普通女学生，唯一的特长是能飞快地弹吉他。毕业将近，少男少女们都想为校园生活留下美好回忆。每个人都向往恋爱，却需要让这份期待化为具体事物。“不如组支乐队吧？”有人提议，众人欣然赞成。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
